title: plugin-dashboard: a header action's click handler keeps its own url grammar and bypasses the ActionRunner (a protocol-relative `//host` is assigned, `mailto:` throws) — and it drops an omitted `actionType` that its own `headerActionDefs` reads as `'url'`
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b) with a security reach, plus a class (c) half in the same handler. `reach:` the contract door that #23077 closes. Read from source at objectui `main` `7af0ab37`, not executed in a browser.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf`, from the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23077 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23101, out-of-scope findings 1 and 2). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## The rule this handler does not follow

Ruling A+ on #12191: the url scheme set "is stated once in the contract and the runtime fulfils exactly that". The contract states it once, as `navigationTargetRefusal` (`packages/spec/src/ui/navigation-target.ts`). The console's `ActionRunner` fulfils it through `classifyNavigationTarget`. Once objectstack-ai/objectstack#23101 lands, `DashboardHeaderActionSchema.actionUrl` refuses a target outside the set when `actionType` is `'url'` or omitted.

## What the handler does (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx` at `7af0ab37`)

1. **A second url grammar** (`:1216`–`:1225`). For `actionType === 'url'` the handler navigates by itself and never reaches the `ActionRunner`:
   - `window.location.assign(actionUrl)` when the value matches `^https?://` OR starts with `//`. A protocol-relative `//host` is refused by the contract set and by `classifyNavigationTarget`, but it is assigned here.
   - Otherwise it calls `window.history.pushState({}, '', actionUrl)`. That throws on `mailto:`, which the contract admits, and it admits a bare relative value such as `thanks`, which the contract refuses.
2. **An omitted `actionType` is dropped at the click** (`:1212`–`:1214`). `if (!actionType || !actionUrl)` logs `Header action missing actionType/actionUrl` and returns. The same file's `headerActionDefs` (`:460`) builds the header action's `ActionDef` with `type: actionType || 'url'`, and objectstack's `os validate` (`validateDashboardActionRefs`) also reads an omitted type as `'url'`. So a contract-legal header action with no `actionType` publishes clean and renders a button that does nothing.

## Wanted

- The header action's click goes through the `ActionRunner`, which owns the type registry and `classifyNavigationTarget`, as every non-url header action already does. ⛔ No scheme list of its own in this file.
- An omitted `actionType` means `'url'` at the click too, as `headerActionDefs` and the contract door read it.
- Pins: `//cdn.example.com/x` is refused at the click; `mailto:` opens; a bare relative value is refused; an omitted-type header action with an `https://` target navigates.

## Seam

`spec:DashboardHeaderActionSchema.actionUrl` / `.actionType` → `renderer: plugin-dashboard DashboardRenderer` header action `handleClick`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, for `DashboardRenderer header action url location.assign protocol-relative bypasses classifyNavigationTarget`: 2 hits, #11211 and #2333, neither this. For `dashboard header action missing actionType dead button console.warn headerActionDefs default url`: 4 hits, #10345, #7281, #2960 and #994, none this.

Dedupe words: DashboardRenderer header action url location.assign; dashboard header actionUrl protocol-relative; classifyNavigationTarget bypass dashboard; header action missing actionType dead button.
